handoffs.what: The card pipeline is live: add a CARDS literal to your fighter script (schema in the art/blender/portraits.py header), then run `python3 art/build.py portraits <id> --skins --only splash,portrait` and measure with `python3 art/tools/card_qa.py <id>`. A low pitch is now safe because render._fit_camera keeps the camera above the floor. Odrum still fails the crown gate (R3 4.9 cm): check with `node art/tools/crown_gate.mjs art/out/fighters/odrum`.

content/vfx.json: give the deluxe skin burdam_almanac an ink-on-parchment vfxTint like the roster's other deluxe lines (ink #2E2A26 core on parchment #D8CDB4 / #A3987F, oxblood #7A2E2A accent). Asked for by burdam-M4.

_design/ROSTER.md:152 (owner lane unclear; route to the doc owner if it is not CW3c): the Almanac Ledger line should match _design/fighters/burdam.md section 9: ledger-ink plum-slate coat and skirt #4D4559, ink-felt cowl #3E3A4C, parchment pauldrons ruled in ink with oxblood margin rules #7A2E2A, parchment hem strip with day-marks, the ruled almanac board on the right hip.

Two pipeline additions you can use (both additive). (1) common/plates._expand_hi now drops its highlight knee from p95 to p80/65/50 when a flat pale surface fills the subject's top 5 %; a card stuck at luma ~199 needs no light changes. (2) A fighter module can define install_card_hooks(); portraits.py calls it on load (Burdam uses it for the render wrappers it otherwise installs only when built). New tools: art/tools/chain_motion.py (GLB chain angle / lag), art/tools/glb_stretch.py (CPU-skinned edge stretch per clip), art/tools/skin_gamecam_delta.py (skin vs base at the game camera), art/tools/decimate_chains.mjs (thins x_ chain tracks, optional --orm-q, to get a GLB back under 1172 KiB).
